svg.title: Three-ended translator: a ring of tunnels
svg.desc: Original connected construction schematic based on Dávila, del Pino and Nguyen. A cutaway reveals a bowl sheet and the two catenoid sheets joined through a gold tunnel belt. An enlargement shows the tunnels. This is not a solved translator.

g.text: Three ends joined through a ring of tunnels
A Scherk-like belt replaces the crossing.
SCHEMATIC · not a solved translator · rims and cut edges are display boundaries
The theorem requires large genus; the displayed period counts are illustrative.
